claim: A check-in that waits on CI waits at most cap_minutes, so, under the 1-hour prompt cache, its wake lands inside the cache. The cap spaces check-ins. It is not a limit on the run.
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching.md, section "Which TTL each request gets": the main conversation gets a 1-hour cache only on a Claude subscription within the plan's included usage. On usage credits (overage), an API key or a cloud provider it gets 5 minutes, and a subagent's or other non-main request gets 5 minutes unless a TTL is chosen. The cap holds only where the 1-hour cache applies.
